FOTRIC Inc. Alarm Platform Access Privacy Policy Introduction Thank you for trusting and using this product's alarm platform! Protecting your personal information and privacy is one of our basic principles. When you use this product, we may collect and use information about you. Through this Privacy Policy (this "Policy"), we want to explain to you how we collect, use, store, disclose and process this information and how we provide you with access to, update, control, and protect it in order to protect your rights in relation to it. In particular, this policy does not apply to products or services provided by third-party companies or individuals ("Third Party Services"). To facilitate your use of our products, our products may contain third-party services or links to them; since third parties will independently collect and process your personal information over which we have no control, we are not responsible for third-party services unless otherwise required by law, and you are responsible for reading and understanding the privacy policies of third party services and making your own judgment about whether to use their services. As this policy is closely related to the products and/or services you use, you are encouraged to read and understand this policy carefully before using our products and/or services, with particular emphasis on our bolded/underlined terms, and to follow the guidelines in this policy when necessary to make the choices you deem appropriate. We have tried to be as concise as possible in the presentation of the relevant technical terms in this policy to facilitate your understanding. By using or continuing to use our products and/or services, you consent to our collection, use, storage, disclosure, and processing of information about you in accordance with this Policy. If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, you may contact us through the means agreed to in Section VI of this Policy.
This policy will help you understand the following: I. How we collect and use your personal information II. How we share, transfer and publicly disclose your personal information III. How we protect and store your personal information IV. Your rights V. How to update this policy VI. How to contact us
A. How we collect and use your personal information (a) In the process of your use of this product, we will collect relevant information in accordance with the following terms to achieve certain functions and to protect your product security. 1. In order to implement the alarm forwarding function (this function requires you to connect the product to the Internet), we will collect your cell phone number, micro signal, pin number, and email address. This information is collected in order to send you an alarm message. We will also collect alarm messages from the server where the product is located for the purpose of forwarding alarm messages to the receiving address configured for the product. Refusal to provide this information will only prevent you from using the alarm forwarding function, but will not affect your normal use of other functions. 2. In order to implement the online upgrade function (this function requires you to connect the product to the Internet), we will collect the IP address, MAC address, and device SN number of the product for the purpose of identifying the device to which the online upgrade command is directed and securing your product. Refusal to provide this information will only prevent you from using the online upgrade function, but will not affect your normal use of other functions. 3. In order to implement the online maintenance function (this function requires you to connect your product to the Internet), we will collect the IP address, MAC address, and device SN number of this product for the purpose of product maintenance docking and identifying the device to which the online maintenance instruction refers, refusing to provide these messages will only prevent you from using the online maintenance function normally, but will not affect your normal use of other functions. You are reminded that: 1. our products and/or services are provided through different carriers, and the specific products/services that different users choose to use and the functions they achieve differ; accordingly, the type and scope of personal information collected and used by specific products may differ, so please refer to the specific product/service functions; 2. If the information you provide to us contains personal information of others, you must ensure that you have legally obtained the authorization of the relevant subject.
II. How we share, transfer and publicly disclose your personal information We will not actively share or transfer your personal information to third parties but will obtain your express consent if there are other cases of sharing or transferring your personal information. As our business continues to grow, we may engage in mergers, acquisitions, asset transfers, and other transactions, and we will inform you of the circumstances and continue to protect or require new controllers to continue to protect your personal information in accordance with laws and regulations and standards no less stringent than those required by this policy. (i) Sharing We will not share your personal information with any company, organization or individual, except for the following circumstances: 1. We may share your personal information with other parties with your express consent. 2. We may share your personal information in accordance with laws and regulations, or in accordance with mandatory requirements of government authorities, and as necessary to fulfill other legal obligations. 3. Sharing with Affiliates: Your personal information may be shared with our affiliates in order to facilitate our provision of products and/or services to you based on this product and to recommend information that may be of interest to you. We will only share personal information that is necessary and is subject to the purposes stated in this policy. Affiliates will again seek your authorized consent if they wish to change the purposes for which personal information is processed. (ii) Transfer We will not transfer your personal information to any company, organization or individual, except for the following: 1. transfer with express consent: after obtaining your express consent, we will transfer your personal information to other parties; 2. in the event of a merger, separation, acquisition, dissolution or bankruptcy and liquidation involving the transfer of personal information, we will inform you of the name or name and contact information of the recipient, and we will require the new company or organization holding your personal information to continue to be bound by this policy, otherwise we will require the company or organization to seek your authorized consent again. (iii) Public Disclosure We will only disclose your personal information publicly if we 1. after obtaining your express consent; (2) Disclosure based on law: We may publicly disclose your personal information when compelled to do so by law, legal process, litigation, or government authorities. In addition, in accordance with relevant laws and regulations and national standards, we may share, transfer, and publicly disclose personal information without the prior authorized consent of the subject of the personal information in the following cases: 1） Directly related to national security and national defense security; 2） Directly related to public safety, public health, and significant public interests 3) directly related to crime investigation, prosecution, trial and execution of judgments, etc; 4） For the purpose of safeguarding the life, property, and other significant legitimate rights and interests of the subject of personal information or other individuals but where it is difficult to obtain his or her consent 5） Personal information disclosed to the public by the subject of the personal information himself/herself; 6） Personal information collected from legitimate public disclosures, such as legitimate news reports, government information disclosure, and other channels. III. How we protect and preserve your personal information (a) How we protect your personal information 1. We have used security measures in accordance with industry standards to protect the personal information you provide against unauthorized access, public disclosure, use, modification, damage, or loss of data. We will take all reasonably practicable steps to protect your personal information. For example, we have established an internal management system and operation procedures, implemented classification management of personal information, adopt corresponding encryption, de-identification, and other security technology measures, reasonably determine the operation authority of personal information handling, and regularly provide security education and training for employees, and develop and organize the implementation of contingency plans for personal information security incidents; 2. We will take all reasonable and feasible measures to ensure that no irrelevant personal information is collected. We will only retain your personal information for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes described in this policy unless an extended retention period is required or permitted by law. The Internet environment is not 100% secure and we will endeavor to ensure or warrant the security of any information you send to us. We recommend that you take active steps to protect the security of your personal information when using this product. 4. In the unfortunate event of a personal information security incident, we will promptly inform you, in accordance with the requirements of laws and regulations, of: the basic situation and possible impact of the security incident, the measures we have taken or will take to deal with it, the suggestions you can independently prevent and reduce the risk, and the remedial measures for you. We will promptly inform you of the event-related situation by email, letter, telephone, push notification, etc. When it is difficult to inform the subject of personal information one by one, we will take a reasonable and effective way to issue an announcement. At the same time, we will also take the initiative to report the disposition of personal information security incidents in accordance with the requirements of regulatory authorities. (II) How we store your personal information 1. Storage location We store your personal information collected within the territory of the People's Republic of China in accordance with the provisions of applicable data protection laws. At present, we do not use, store, share, or disclose your personal information in a cross-border business or transfer your personal information outside of China. 2. Storage Time We will only retain your personal information for as long as is necessary for the purposes described in this policy and for as long as required by laws, regulations, and regulatory requirements. We will retain your personal information for the period required by applicable data protection laws. After the legal retention period, we will delete or anonymize your personal information. IV. Your rights In accordance with the relevant Chinese laws, regulations, and standards, as well as the common practices of other countries and regions, we protect your right to exercise the following rights with respect to your personal information: (a) Access to your personal information You have the right to access your personal information, except for the exceptions provided by laws and regulations. If you wish to exercise your right access to your data, you can do so yourself through the following: http://alarm.fotric.cn/asyncTask/m2/index.html. If you are unable to access such personal information through the link above, please contact us through info@fotric.com and we will get back to you within 30 days. For other personal information generated in the course of your use of our products or services, we will provide it to you as long as we do not require excessive input. If you wish to exercise your right to data access, please contact us through info@fotric.com. (ii) Correction of your personal information When you discover an error in the personal information we process about you, you have the right to request that we make a correction. You can request a correction by using the methods listed under "(a) Access to your personal information". If you are unable to correct such personal information through the link above, please reach out to info@fotric.com. We will respond to your request for correction within 30 days. (iii) Deletion of your personal information You may request us to delete your personal information in the following cases: 1. if our handling of personal information violates laws and regulations; 2. if we collect and use your personal information without your consent 3. if our handling of personal information violates the agreement with you; 4. if you no longer use our products or services, or if you cancel your account; 5. if we no longer provide products or services to you. If we decide to respond to your request for deletion, we will also simultaneously notify the entities from which we obtained your personal information and request that they delete it promptly, unless otherwise required by law or regulation, or unless those entities have your independent authorization. When you delete information from our service, we may not immediately delete the corresponding information in our backup system but will delete it when the backup is updated. (iv) Change the scope of your authorized consent Each business function requires some basic personal information in order to be completed. You may give or withdraw your consent at any time for the collection and use of additional personal information collected. You can do this yourself by clicking on the system configuration page, selecting the Alarm Platform Access tab, disabling Alarm Platform Access, and then clicking Save to complete the withdrawal of consent. When you withdraw your consent, we will no longer process the corresponding personal information. However, your decision to withdraw consent will not affect the processing of personal information previously carried out based on your authorization. (V) Cancellation of accounts by personal information subjects You may cancel your previously registered account at any time by contacting us through the contact information in Section 6. After canceling your account, we will stop providing you with products or services and delete your personal information upon your request, except as otherwise provided by law or regulation. (f) Responding to your request above For security purposes, you may be required to provide a written request or otherwise prove your identity. We may ask you to verify your identity first before processing your request. We will respond within thirty days. In principle, we do not charge a fee for your reasonable requests, but we will charge a cost fee for multiple repetitive requests that exceed reasonable limits, as appropriate. We may deny requests that are unwarrantedly repetitive, require excessive technical means (for example, requiring the development of new systems or fundamental changes to current practices), pose a risk to the legal rights of others, or are highly impractical (for example, involving the backup of information stored on tapes). We will not be able to respond to your request in the following cases: 1. it is related to the performance of the obligations of the controller of personal information under laws and regulations 2. directly related to national security or national defense security 3. directly related to public safety, public health, or vital public interests 4. directly related to criminal investigations, prosecutions, trials and enforcement of sentences, etc; 5. the controller of personal information has sufficient evidence that the subject of personal information has subjective malice or abuse The use of rights; 6. in order to protect the life, property and other significant legitimate rights and interests of the subject of personal information or other individuals but 6. it is difficult to obtain the consent of the person concerned; 7. responding to the request of the subject of personal information will lead to serious damage to the legitimate rights and interests of the subject of personal information or other individuals or organizations 8. where commercial secrets are involved.
V. How to update this policy We may revise or change this policy from time to time, you can get the updated policy after upgrading the product software through the function of product online upgrade, then we will collect, use, store and process your personal information in accordance with the updated policy. We will not reduce your rights under this personal information protection policy without your express consent. We will post any changes to this policy on this page. For material changes, we will also provide more prominent notice (including, for certain services, email notification of specific changes to our Personal Information Protection Policy). Material changes to this policy include, but are not limited to: 1. a significant change in our service model. Such as the purpose of processing personal information, the type of personal information processed, and the manner in which personal information is used; 2. Significant changes in our ownership structure, organizational structure, etc. Such as change of ownership caused by business restructuring, bankruptcy, and merger, etc; 3. changes in the main recipients of personal information sharing, transfer, or public disclosure; 4. significant changes in your rights to participate in the processing of personal information and the manner in which they are exercised 5. When there is a change in the department responsible for handling personal information security, contact information, and complaint channels of us 6. When the personal information security impact assessment report indicates that there is a high risk. We will also keep an older version of this policy on file for your review.
VI. How to contact us If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions about this personal information protection policy, contact us through the following ways: 1. Contact number: 400-821-1226 2. E-mail: info@fotric.com We have set up a dedicated department for personal information protection (or personal information protection officer), you can contact it through the following ways: Mail to the following address. Building 14, Lane 2500, Xiupu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China [Personal Information Protection Officer] (Attention) Zip code: 201315 In general, we will reply within thirty days. If you are not satisfied with our response, especially if our personal information processing behavior has harmed your legitimate rights and interests, you can also seek a solution through the following external means: file a lawsuit with the court with jurisdiction in the defendant's domicile."
